_comment: The bundled stdlib is a separate regression cohort so a strong runtime-core score cannot conceal transform regressions. The 24 August 2026 v1 baseline scored 88.78% overall / 93.98% covered across 633 mutants: 553 killed, 9 timed out, 36 survived, 35 uncovered. Killed mutants alone score 87.36%, so the 87% floor does not depend on timeouts. Dates, math, strings, and types each scored 100%; arrays are the remaining hardening surface.
